HolyAkita.transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender using safeSub/safeAdd
HolyAkita.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) moves tokens using allowance and balance updates via safe math
HolyAkita.approve(address spender, uint tokens) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no double-spend check
HolyAkita.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval
HolyAkita.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant returns remaining allowance
HolyAkita.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant returns the token balance of tokenOwner
HolyAkita.totalSupply() constant returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
HolyAkita.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner external call to arbitrary ERC20 transfer
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner sets newOwner
Owned.acceptOwnership() requires msg.sender == newOwner then completes the ownership handover
HolyAkita() constructor that initialises symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-allocates all tokens to a fixed address
HolyAkita payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure addition guarded with require(c >= a)
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure subtraction guarded with require(b <= a)
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure multiplication guarded with require(a == 0 || c / a == b)
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure division guarded with require(b > 0)

edges.reason: owner state variable is assigned from msg.sender in the Owned constructor, making ownership caller controlled
transfer debits balances[msg.sender], so the caller address flows into the transfer logic
transferFrom uses msg.sender to deduct the spender allowance allowed[from][msg.sender]
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address
approveAndCall writes the allowance for msg.sender and forwards msg.sender to the external callback
transferOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender == owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before completing the ownership handover

the onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership reads the owner state variable
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner) and overwrites owner
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner and promotes newOwner to owner

allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]
